findings.finding: The shared last block template can replay only while formatter SELECT, no candidate, no block_ready, no beat_pending and matching registered output tag. Any ordinary block write reassigns or invalidates the owner.
SLH replay changes domain byte, hash-step word, 128-bit digest; LMS replay changes step byte and 256-bit digest. Remaining frame, initial CV and tag retain the same owner.
Direct injection starts from registered SHA256 output_cv. The feed-forward arithmetic remains behind the original output register.
compression_ready gate prevents dropping replay when another token occupies the recycled ring; fallback uses ordinary formatter.
SLH first 22 bytes are ADRS; U1/U2 initial A/E round uses address words while returned digest reaches message schedule. Input control/mux and message schedule must be examined in actual synthesis.

block_ready-only data selection is observationally equivalent to replay_take selection on all accepted compression inputs: block_ready=1 excludes replay_take and chooses normal data; block_ready=0 can present input_valid only through replay_take and chooses replay data. Invalid-input data changes are unobserved. The data path no longer depends on replay handshake/arbitration/reset decode.

limitations: Static audit is not functional verification. Root agent runs recipe and full Sign regressions.
100MHz synthesis is diagnostic only and is not proof of 150MHz routed timing.
